subject: Exec approval request — Medstack legacy transition discount
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@medstack.com>, Medstack Sales <sales@medstack.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: legacy-customer transition discount for Medstack (12mo commit)

Hi Mina / Marcus,

Quick ask — Medstack (longstanding pilot/legacy customer) is in transition off a self-hosted trial and wants a predictable hosted contract. They are asking for a 25% off our standard Hosted API usage rates for a 12-month committed volume. Deal summary attached.

Why this is time-sensitive:
- They are mid-migration and need pricing confirmed to commit to a 12-mo, $1.8M ARR-equivalent ramp (50% consumption in Q1, full run-rate by Q3).
- Competing vendors have offered a 20–30% blended concession; losing this would likely push them to pause migration.

Impact / mitigation:
- Estimated incremental annual gross margin impact at 25%: ~11% of deal value once amortized (details in Deal_Economics_Medstack.xlsx).
- We can attach a one-year minimum committed usage SOW + automatic revert to list pricing after 12 months.
- Will require finance sign-off on revenue recognition and legal to tighten data-handling language (Medstack is healthcare-adjacent).

Attachments: Medstack_HostedAPI_Pricing_Sheet.pdf, Medstack_SOW_Draft.docx, Deal_Economics_Medstack.xlsx

Ask: Exec approval to grant a 25% hosted-usage discount (one-year term) conditioned on the attached SOW and a minimum monthly commit. If approved, I'll loop in Finance & Legal to finalize DocuSign.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@medstack.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: legacy-customer transition discount for Medstack (12mo commit)

Ben — thanks for the summary and attachments. A couple quick questions before I can sign off: 

1) Can you confirm the expected incremental lifetime value and churn delta if we retain vs lose them? Your spreadsheet shows ARR cadence but I want LTV sensitivity at both 20% and 25% concession.
2) Are there alternatives to a straight percentage (e.g., onboarding credits, tiered ramp discounts, or a $/token cap) that protect unit economics?
3) Any outstanding security or compliance asks? If Legal has to add non-standard clauses that extend review >2 weeks, that changes the timeline.

Please reply with the LTV sensitivity and recommended concession structure. If the economics work and Legal is clean, I can approve an exception up to 25% with Finance conditions.

-Mina
Mina Haddad | SVP Sales, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

On 2026-12-18 09:12, Ben Carter wrote:
> Quick ask — Medstack (longstanding pilot/legacy customer) is in transition off a self-hosted trial and wants a predictable hosted contract. They are asking for a 25% off our standard Hosted API usage rates for a 12-month committed volume. Deal summary attached.
>

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@medstack.com>, Medstack Sales <sales@medstack.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: legacy-customer transition discount for Medstack (12mo commit)

Mina — thanks, answered inline and attached the sensitivity workbook.

1) LTV sensitivity: At list pricing the 3-year NPV = $3.9M. At a 20% concession NPV = $3.4M. At 25% concession NPV = $3.2M. Loss probability without concession is estimated at ~60% (histors: legacy pilots). With concession and the commit, probability of retention >85%. (See tab 'LTV_sensitivity' in Deal_Economics_Medstack.xlsx.)

2) Alternatives: proposed structure in the SOW: 10% immediate discount + 15% performance rebate (paid quarterly) tied to usage thresholds. This preserves upside if they over-index. Chris prefers a straight 25% because of procurement simplicity.

3) Security/compliance: Medstack has an in-house SOC-like checklist. Legal has reviewed and flagged a single item around dataset residency; they asked for an auditable export policy. Legal says this is a standard addendum and should not block signing if we limit the clause to operational controls rather than contractual warranties.

Finance note: incremental margin hit is manageable given the strategic retention value; finance review requested once we finalize the concession language.

Deal links: https://app.redwood.ai/deals/DEAL-78321 (proposal + pricing)

If you can greenlight up to 25% with the condition that we require a 12-month committed volume and the performance rebate option as fallback, I'll push to get DocuSign today.

Ben

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Finance Team <finance@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@medstack.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: legacy-customer transition discount for Medstack (12mo commit) — APPROVED w/ conditions

Team — I reviewed Ben's economics and Mina's conditions. I approve a one-year, 25% Hosted API usage concession for Medstack (DEAL-78321) under the following conditions: 

- Must have a signed 12-month minimum committed usage SOW (attach Medstack_SOW_Draft.docx)
- Include the tiered rebate fallback: 10% upfront + up to 15% back based on quarterly usage thresholds (as outlined in Ben's alternative).
- Finance to validate revenue recognition and attach a planned margin recovery schedule.
- Legal to accept the operational residency addendum language (no new warranty or indemnity exposure).
- Limit approval to US region consumption only; any APAC/EU expansion requires separate sign-off.

Ben — please coordinate with Finance & Legal, and route the final DocuSign package to me and Finance for countersignature. Chris — appreciate the patience; we'll get the finalized DocuSign link to you once legal/finance have cleared.

Marcus Lin | VP, Commercial Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0122
